selection: first 100 rows, indices 0 through 99; includes the ten development examples already used in Stages 1 and 2; remaining 400 not evaluated
transition_text:

budget_definition: normal generated pre-close tokens, including opening marker and whitespace; forced cue tokens are additional and timed
primary_accuracy: correct final answer AND normal EOS completion, out of all 100; cap hits and missing final answers are failures
secondary_accuracy: correct extracted boxed answer regardless of normal EOS completion
grader: last complete boxed answer; canonical exact match then math-verify 0.9.0 mathematical equivalence; extraction/parser ambiguities reviewed without changing generation
timing: same instrumented single-request Transformers path for all configurations; CUDA-synchronized generate wall time, includes cutoff and answer, excludes load/tokenization/queue/warmup
uncertainty: paired per-problem bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 622203; exploratory candidate selection on development examples, not confirmation of a 3pp floor
execution: 30 tasks: task % 6 selects configuration, task // 6 selects a contiguous 20-problem shard; at most six concurrent L40S allocations; per-item resumable records
